flags.water-sewer: Whether this parcel has water and sewer service is unknown and hasn't been scored [utilities.water_sewer]. You should reach out to check on this directly [utilities.water_sewer].
flags.adu: There's a proposed rule (not yet law, held in council with a hearing date listed) that could allow up to two small accessory dwelling units by right in this zoning district [zoning.district, reform.status]. Since it's still proposed, it can't be relied on as current law [reform.status].
flags.parking-minimum: The same proposed, not-yet-law bill would remove required off-street parking minimums, which could free up land and money for more housing [reform.status]. This is not yet in effect [reform.status].
flags.affordable-housing-bonus: The proposed bill also includes an optional Affordable Housing Bonus, and this parcel is outside the Inclusionary Housing Overlay [overlay.iz, reform.status]. This bonus is not law yet [reform.status].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in an area with low assessed land values, so a project here may likely need extra gap financing; this is just a note, not a penalty to the score [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a lower-value neighborhood, it may qualify for infill or blight-related scoring in some funding programs, but this should be checked against current program rules [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: The parcel is owned by the City, which may make it easier (though not guaranteed) to acquire through a public disposition process [owner.type].
